_metadata.description: OT-P2-001 — operator console for plans, phases, staleness, handoffs, triage, and velocity.

requirements.title: Operator console renders plans, phase progress, staleness, handoffs, and velocity
requirements.description: A React/Vite console lets operators view and manage plans, phase progress, staleness tiers, handoff records (canonical + linked prose), candidate-finding triage, and velocity trends, using the vrooli-default design with status-color semantics and the template's i18n + accessibility seams.

validation.notes: Boards render loading/empty/error/success states; testids + axe-clean; target ui/src/features.
BAS: operator can open a plan, view phases + staleness, and triage a candidate finding.
